name: TTP Analysis
description: Analyzing and documenting adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using structured frameworks. Covers MITRE ATT&CK mapping, behavioral pattern analysis, technique evolution tracking, and translating TTP intelligence into actionable detection and hunting guidance for defensive operations.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to TTP analysis or the MITRE ATT&CK framework

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the concept of TTPs and the structure of the MITRE ATT&CK framework
evidence: Can explain the ATT&CK matrix structure (tactics, techniques, sub-techniques)
Understands why TTP analysis is more durable than IOC-based detection
Familiar with the distinction between tactics, techniques, and procedures

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Maps observed behaviors to ATT&CK techniques under supervision
evidence: Maps malware and incident artifacts to ATT&CK techniques under guidance
Documents observed procedures with supporting evidence
Creates basic ATT&CK Navigator layers for engagements
Mappings reviewed by authorized analyst for accuracy

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs TTP analysis and produces detection-oriented intelligence
evidence: Conducts thorough TTP analysis for engagements and produces ATT&CK-mapped reports across 3+ cases
Translates TTP intelligence into detection rule concepts or hunting hypotheses
Identifies technique variations and procedure-level distinctions between actors
TTP analysis products pass analytical quality review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced behavioral analysis; identifies technique trends; mentors analysts
evidence: Identifies novel techniques or undocumented sub-technique variants
Tracks technique evolution across campaigns and adversary groups over time
Develops structured TTP comparison methodologies for campaign correlation
Mentors junior analysts on TTP analysis and ATT&CK mapping rigor

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines TTP analysis methodology; contributes to framework development; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's TTP analysis methodology and standards
Contributes technique submissions or refinements to MITRE ATT&CK or similar frameworks
Publishes original research on adversary behavior patterns
Trains teams on TTP analysis and develops training scenarios

assessment_methods.description: Given a malware analysis report or incident timeline, produce a complete ATT&CK mapping with procedure-level detail and detection recommendations
Review ATT&CK-mapped engagement reports for mapping accuracy, evidence support, and detection utility

mitre_attack.note: This skill directly covers ATT&CK framework proficiency
